description: A filter using a single value against a column. The number of values depends on the operator: IS_NULL and IS_NOT_NULL take no values; BETWEEN takes exactly two values (lower and upper bound); the relational comparison operators (EQUAL when a single value, NOT_EQUAL, GREATER_THAN, LESS_THAN, GREATER_THAN_OR_EQUAL, LESS_THAN_OR_EQUAL) take exactly one value; LIKE, EQUAL, and IN accept one or more values that are combined in an OR relationship.

columnName.description: name of the column to filter

operator.description: Determines the filter operation to perform
operator.name: ColumnSingleValueFilterOperator

enum.name: LIKE
enum.description: The LIKE operation. Use wildcard '%' in value string for prefix/suffix matching. Multiple values will be joined in an OR relationship.

enum.name: GREATER_THAN
enum.description: The greater than (>) operation. Takes exactly one value.

enum.name: LESS_THAN
enum.description: The less than (<) operation. Takes exactly one value.

enum.name: GREATER_THAN_OR_EQUAL
enum.description: The greater than or equal (>=) operation. Takes exactly one value.

enum.name: LESS_THAN_OR_EQUAL
enum.description: The less than or equal (<=) operation. Takes exactly one value.

enum.name: NOT_EQUAL
enum.description: The not equal (<>) operation. Takes exactly one value.

enum.name: IS_NULL
enum.description: The IS NULL operation. Takes no values.

enum.name: IS_NOT_NULL
enum.description: The IS NOT NULL operation. Takes no values.

enum.name: BETWEEN
enum.description: The BETWEEN operation. Takes exactly two values: the inclusive lower and upper bounds.
